# ShareKart

> A trusted local marketplace to rent, sell, or donate products and services with verified users and escrow protection.

ShareKart connects people in the same community to share items — list things to rent out, sell, or donate, and discover what neighbors are offering. Built-in KYC verification, OTP-based handover, and a donor leaderboard help build trust.

## Pages

- [Browse Marketplace](/): Discover items available to rent, buy, or claim for free near you.
- [List an Item](/list-item): Publish a product or service for rent, sale, or donation.
- [Donor Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top community donors ranked by contributions.
